name: example-react-project
title: React Project
description:
Multi-file Vite + React + TypeScript project (not a single HTML file).
Generation writes a real project tree — package.json, vite.config.ts,
index.html, src/** — into the project root, styled by the active design
system's tokens.css. Export as a ZIP, or install + build for a static
preview.

query.en: Create a multi-file React + TypeScript project for {{audience}} using the {{framework}} framework: a real {{artifactKind}} with a clean component split, typed props, and a production-ready structure. The project is auto-seeded before your first turn with the {{variant}} base — do NOT re-scaffold or copy a seed; read the existing files (package.json, src/**) and build the brief's real screens on top. Drive color/type/spacing from the active design system's tokens — find the seed's token stylesheet (its path differs per seed: `src/styles/tokens.css`, `src/app/tokens.css` or `src/app/brand-tokens.css`) and use those custom properties instead of hardcoded values, without fighting the seed's existing theme. Styling approach: {{styling}}. Package manager: {{packageManager}}. Follow `references/structure.md` for the chosen framework; do NOT produce a single self-contained HTML file. IMPORTANT — if {{variant}} names A2UI: the deliverable is `a2ui-spec.json` at the project root and NOTHING else. Compose it from the node types and props declared in `src/authoring/catalog.ts`; `/a2ui` gate-validates and renders it. Do NOT write or edit any .tsx/.ts, do not add routes or components, and treat `src/authoring/**`, `src/genui/**` and `src/blocks/**` as read-only — writing a React screen there means the run looks finished while /a2ui still shows the seed's placeholder spec.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{audience}} 使用 {{framework}} 框架创建一个多文件 React + TypeScript 项目：一个真实的 {{artifactKind}}，组件拆分清晰、props 有类型、结构可用于生产。项目在你的第一轮之前已用 {{variant}} 基底自动生成种子——不要重新脚手架或复制种子，请读取已有文件（package.json、src/**）并在其上构建简报所需的真实页面。颜色/字体/间距从当前设计系统的 tokens 驱动 —— 先找到种子的 token 样式表（路径按种子而异：`src/styles/tokens.css`、`src/app/tokens.css` 或 `src/app/brand-tokens.css`），使用其中的自定义属性而非硬编码值，且不要与种子已有主题冲突。样式方式：{{styling}}。包管理器：{{packageManager}}。按所选框架遵循 `references/structure.md`；不要输出单个独立 HTML 文件。 重要 —— 如果 {{variant}} 指定 A2UI：交付物只有项目根目录的 `a2ui-spec.json`，没有其他文件。请使用 `src/authoring/catalog.ts` 中声明的节点类型与属性来组装；`/a2ui` 会做校验与渲染。不要写或修改任何 .tsx/.ts，不要新增路由或组件，并将 `src/authoring/**`、`src/genui/**`、`src/blocks/**` 视为只读 —— 在那里写 React 页面会让运行看起来完成了，而 /a2ui 仍显示种子的占位 spec。
